headline: Prologis to Acquire Liberty Property Trust for $12.6 Billion
summary:
SAN FRANCISCO and WAYNE, Pa., Oct.  27, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Prologis, Inc. (NYSE: PLD) and Liberty Property Trust (NYSE: LPT) today announced that the two companies have entered into a definitive merger agreement by which Prologis will acquire Liberty in an all-stock transaction, valued at approximately $12.6 billion, including the assumption of debt.
